title: Household Lifetime Plans — Alignment Services & Plans Enrollment Terms
content:
## Who may buy a household plan

A customer who holds an active lifetime alignment plan (Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan or Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance) may buy a plan of the same line for another vehicle they own at the household price; the plan they already hold is the household plan, and the new plan is a household plan. The vehicle's class must be in the line's list of eligible vehicle classes and the vehicle must be in personal use, and the household plan is valid only on the vehicle it is bought for.

> A household plan is sold only after the vehicle it is bought for carries no active alignment service or plan.

## Price and purchase visit

For a household plan sold under this policy, and only for such a plan, the purchase price is the household price in place of the tire bundle price, a household plan is never charged to a Crestline Fleet Account, and no tire bundle or fleet discount is combined with the household price. Every plan that is neither a household plan nor a renewal of an expired month-based plan is priced at the line's plan price less its tire bundle discount when a Crestline tire set was installed on the same vehicle within the tire bundle window before the purchase date (that date included), and at the plan price otherwise, the bundle discount never combined with a fleet discount and a fleet account's discount applying on a fleet ticket only where the line allows it.

For a household plan sold under this policy, and only for such a plan, the first alignment is performed on the purchase visit as an included alignment unless the vehicle has already been aligned that day under the holding the plan replaces, in which case no second alignment is performed on that visit. Every plan that is neither a household plan nor a renewal of an expired month-based plan keeps its purchase-visit alignment.

## The customer's purchase: `enroll_household_alignment_plan_f0fe3800`

**Capability.** The customer buys, for another vehicle of their own, a lifetime alignment plan of the same line as the active lifetime plan they already hold, at the household price the agent quoted. On success a new active alignment plan of that line is created for the given vehicle, dated today, with no expiration date, the purchase odometer, tender and price given, and a newly issued store ticket number; the customer sees the new plan on their profile.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `enroll_household_alignment_plan_f0fe3800` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `household_plan_id` | reference number of the customer's active lifetime alignment plan whose line the new plan takes, from the alignment plan lookup (text) |
| `vehicle_id` | reference number of the vehicle the new plan is bought for, from the vehicle lookup (text) |
| `store_id` | reference number of the Crestline store the plan is sold through, from the store lookup (text) |
| `purchase_odometer` | odometer of the vehicle on the purchase date, integer miles, as written on that vehicle's work order of the day |
| `payment_method` | tender the customer pays with: `cash_or_debit` (cash or a debit card) or `bank_card` (an outside bank credit card); `crestline_card` and `fleet_account` are not accepted, because tickets on those accounts post through them |
| `purchase_price` | price of the new plan, USD with 2 decimal places, before tax; the tool rounds to the nearest cent when more digits are given |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `alignment_plan_id` (the new plan), `variant_name` (the line taken from the household plan), `vehicle_id`, `status` (the text active), `purchase_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `purchase_ticket_number` (T- followed by 8 digits) and `purchase_price`. A tender outside the accepted values, or a `household_plan_id` that is not a lifetime plan, returns a text starting with "Error:" and changes nothing.
